judgment.english: Great success; constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 天行健，君子以自強不息。
image.english: Heaven moves strongly. The noble person strengthens himself without ceasing.

lines.english: Hidden dragon: do not act.
A dragon appears in the field. It is beneficial to see the great person.

lines.chinese: 君子終日乾乾，夕惕若厲。无咎。
lines.english: The noble person works vigorously all day and remains watchful at night. Danger; no blame.
Perhaps leaping in the deep. No blame.
A flying dragon in heaven. It is beneficial to see the great person.
An overreaching dragon has regret.

useNine.english: See a group of dragons without a head. Good fortune.

judgment.chinese: 元亨。利牝馬之貞。君子有攸往，先迷後得主，利，西南得朋，東北喪朋。安貞吉。
judgment.english: Great success. The constancy of a mare is beneficial. The noble person has somewhere to go: first lost, later finding a master; beneficial. Gain companions in the southwest; lose companions in the northeast. Peaceful constancy brings good fortune.

image.chinese: 地勢坤。君子以厚德載物。
image.english: The disposition of earth is yielding. The noble person bears things with ample virtue.

lines.english: Treading on frost: hard ice arrives.
Straight, square, great. Without practice, nothing is unbeneficial.

lines.chinese: 含章可貞，或從王事，无成有終。
lines.english: Holding beauty within, one may remain constant. Perhaps serving the king's affairs: no achievement of one's own, but a completion.
Tie up the sack. No blame, no praise.
Yellow lower garments: great good fortune.
Dragons fight in the open country. Their blood is dark and yellow.

judgment.chinese: 元亨，利貞。勿用有攸往。利建侯。
judgment.english: Great success; constancy is beneficial. Do not undertake a journey. Establishing lords is beneficial.

image.chinese: 雲雷、屯。君子以經綸。
image.english: Clouds and thunder: Sprouting. The noble person orders and arranges.

lines.english: Lingering about. Remaining constant is beneficial. Establishing lords is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 屯如邅如，乘馬班如。匪寇，婚媾。女子貞不字，十年乃字。
lines.english: Difficulty and circling; horses and carriage turn about. Not robbers: marriage seekers. The woman remains constant and does not become betrothed; after ten years she does.

lines.chinese: 即鹿無虞，惟入于林中，君子幾不如舍，往吝。
lines.english: Pursuing deer without a forester, one merely enters the forest. The noble person sees the first signs: better to abandon it. Going brings shame.

lines.chinese: 乘馬班如，求婚媾。往吉，无不利。
lines.english: Horses and carriage turn about. Seek marriage. Going brings good fortune; nothing is unbeneficial.
Hoarding one's richness. Small constancy brings good fortune; great constancy brings misfortune.
Horses and carriage turn about. Tears of blood flow in streams.

judgment.chinese: 亨。匪我求童蒙，童蒙來求我。初筮告，再三瀆，瀆則不告。利貞。
judgment.english: Success. I do not seek the ignorant youth; the ignorant youth seeks me. At the first divination I inform him. A second and third are disrespectful; when disrespected I do not inform. Constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 山下出泉，蒙。君子以果行育德。
image.english: A spring emerges below the mountain: Youthful Ignorance. The noble person acts resolutely and nurtures virtue.

lines.chinese: 發蒙，利用刑人，用說桎梏，以往吝。
lines.english: Opening ignorance. Punishing people is beneficial; use it to remove fetters. Going further brings shame.
Encompassing ignorance brings good fortune. Taking a wife brings good fortune. The son can manage the household.

lines.chinese: 勿用取女，見金夫，不有躬。无攸利。
lines.english: Do not take this woman: seeing a wealthy man, she does not keep possession of herself. Nothing is beneficial.
Confined ignorance. Shame.
Youthful ignorance. Good fortune.
Striking ignorance. Being a robber is unbeneficial; resisting robbers is beneficial.

judgment.chinese: 有孚，光亨。貞吉。利涉大川。
judgment.english: There is trust: bright success. Constancy brings good fortune. Crossing the great river is beneficial.

image.chinese: 雲上於天，需。君子以飲食宴樂。
image.english: Clouds rise above heaven: Waiting. The noble person eats, drinks, feasts and enjoys.

lines.english: Waiting in the outskirts. Perseverance is beneficial. No blame.
Waiting on sand. Some small words; in the end good fortune.
Waiting in mud brings robbers.
Waiting in blood. Come out from the pit.
Waiting with wine and food. Constancy brings good fortune.

lines.chinese: 入于穴，有不速之客三人來，敬之終吉。
lines.english: Entering the pit. Three uninvited guests arrive. Respect them; in the end good fortune.

judgment.chinese: 有孚窒，惕，中吉，終凶。利見大人。不利涉大川。
judgment.english: There is trust, but obstruction. Be watchful: good fortune midway; misfortune at the end. Seeing the great person is beneficial. Crossing the great river is unbeneficial.

image.chinese: 天與水違行，訟。君子以作事謀始。
image.english: Heaven and water move apart: Dispute. The noble person plans the beginning when undertaking affairs.

lines.english: Do not prolong the affair. Some small words; in the end good fortune.

lines.chinese: 不克訟，歸而逋其邑，人三百戶无眚。
lines.english: Unable to prevail in dispute, return and flee. In one's town of three hundred households there is no calamity.

lines.chinese: 食舊德，貞厲，終吉。或從王事无成。
lines.english: Live on former virtue. Constancy is dangerous; in the end good fortune. Perhaps serving the king's affairs, without achievement of one's own.

lines.chinese: 不克訟，復即命，渝。安貞吉。
lines.english: Unable to prevail in dispute, return and accept the mandate; change. Peaceful constancy brings good fortune.
Dispute: great good fortune.

lines.chinese: 或錫之鞶、帶，終朝三褫之。
lines.english: Perhaps granted a ceremonial belt, only to have it stripped away three times before the morning ends.

judgment.english: Constancy. For a mature leader, good fortune; no blame.

image.chinese: 地中有水，師。君子以容民畜眾。
image.english: Water within the earth: The Army. The noble person embraces the people and gathers the multitude.

lines.english: The army goes out with discipline. Otherwise, even what is good brings misfortune.

lines.chinese: 在師中，吉、无咎，王三錫命。
lines.english: In the army's midst: good fortune, no blame. The king bestows the command three times.
The army perhaps carries corpses. Misfortune.
The army camps on the left. No blame.

lines.chinese: 田有禽。利執言，无咎。長子帥師，弟子輿尸，貞凶。
lines.english: There is game in the field. Holding to the word is beneficial; no blame. The eldest son leads the army; younger men carry corpses. Constancy brings misfortune.

lines.chinese: 大君有命，開國承家，小人勿用。
lines.english: The great ruler issues a mandate: establish states and inherit houses. Do not employ petty people.

judgment.chinese: 吉。原筮元，永貞无咎。不寧方來，後夫凶。
judgment.english: Good fortune. Examine the divination: great, lasting constancy; no blame. The unsettled come. For the latecomer, misfortune.

image.chinese: 地上有水，比。先王以建萬國，親諸侯。
image.english: Water upon the earth: Joining. The former kings established myriad states and drew the lords close.

lines.chinese: 有孚比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，終來，有它吉。
lines.english: Join with trust: no blame. Trust fills an earthen jar; in the end other good fortune comes.
Joining from within. Constancy brings good fortune.
Joining with the wrong people.
Joining outwardly. Constancy brings good fortune.

lines.chinese: 顯比，王用三驅，失前禽，邑人不誡，吉。
lines.english: Manifest joining. The king uses a three-sided hunt, losing the game ahead. The townspeople are not warned. Good fortune.
Joining without a head. Misfortune.

judgment.english: Success. Dense clouds, no rain, from our western outskirts.

image.chinese: 風行天上，小畜。君子以懿文德。
image.english: Wind moves above heaven: Small Restraint. The noble person refines patterned virtue.

lines.english: Return by one's own way. What blame could there be? Good fortune.
Drawn back together. Good fortune.
The carriage loses its spokes. Husband and wife turn their eyes against each other.
There is trust: blood departs and fear comes out. No blame.
Trust binds together. Rich together with one's neighbors.

lines.chinese: 既雨既處，尚德載。婦貞厲。月幾望，君子征凶。
lines.english: Rain has fallen; rest has come. Honor virtue's accumulation. The wife's constancy is dangerous. The moon is nearly full. The noble person's advance brings misfortune.

judgment.english: Treading on the tiger's tail: it does not bite the person. Success.

image.chinese: 上天下澤，履。君子以辯上下，定民志。
image.english: Heaven above, lake below: Treading. The noble person distinguishes high and low and settles the people's purpose.

lines.english: Tread simply and go. No blame.
Tread a level road. The secluded person's constancy brings good fortune.

lines.chinese: 眇能視，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人凶。武人為于大君。
lines.english: The one-eyed can see, the lame can walk. Tread on the tiger's tail: it bites the person; misfortune. A warrior acts as the great ruler.
Tread on the tiger's tail, fearful and cautious. In the end good fortune.
Decisive treading. Constancy is dangerous.
Examine the treading and consider its signs. On its completion, great good fortune.

judgment.english: The small departs, the great arrives. Good fortune; success.

image.chinese: 天地交，泰。后以財成天地之道，輔相天地之宜，以左右民。
image.english: Heaven and earth join: Peace. The ruler shapes the way of heaven and earth, assists their proper workings, and thereby supports the people.

lines.english: Pull up thatch, roots entwined with its kind. Advancing brings good fortune.

lines.chinese: 苞荒，用馮河，不遐遺。朋亡，得尚于中行。
lines.english: Encompass the wild, use the river crossing, do not leave the distant behind. Companions disappear. One gains honor through the middle course.

lines.chinese: 无平不陂，无往不復。艱貞，无咎。勿恤其孚，于食有福。
lines.english: No level without a slope, no going without return. Constancy in difficulty: no blame. Do not worry about trust; in food there is blessing.

lines.chinese: 翩翩，不富以其鄰，不戒以孚。
lines.english: Fluttering together, not rich, with one's neighbors; without warning, through trust.
Di Yi marries off the maiden. Blessing and great good fortune.

lines.chinese: 城復于隍，勿用師，自邑告命、貞吝。
lines.english: The city wall falls back into the moat. Do not use the army. Announce the mandate from one's town. Constancy brings shame.

judgment.chinese: 否之匪人。不利君子貞。大往小來。
judgment.english: Obstruction through unsuitable people. The noble person's constancy is unbeneficial. The great departs; the small arrives.

image.chinese: 天地不交，否。君子以儉德辟難，不可榮以祿。
image.english: Heaven and earth do not join: Obstruction. The noble person conserves virtue to avoid trouble and cannot be honored with a stipend.

lines.english: Pull up thatch, roots entwined with its kind. Constancy brings good fortune and success.
Encompassing and accepting: good fortune for petty people; obstruction for the great person. Success.
Encompassing shame.
There is a mandate: no blame. Those of like kind share the blessing.

lines.chinese: 休否，大人吉。其亡其亡，繫于苞桑。
lines.english: Rest from obstruction. Good fortune for the great person. 'It may perish, it may perish!' Tie it to a clump of mulberry trees.
Overturning obstruction. First obstruction, afterward joy.

judgment.chinese: 同人于野，亨。利涉大川。利君子貞。
judgment.english: Joining people in the open country: success. Crossing the great river is beneficial. The noble person's constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 天與火、同人。君子以類族辨物。
image.english: Heaven together with fire: Joining People. The noble person groups clans and distinguishes things.

lines.english: Joining people at the gate. No blame.
Joining people within the clan. Shame.

lines.chinese: 伏戎于莽，升其高陵，三歲不興。
lines.english: Hide troops in the thicket; ascend the high hill. For three years do not rise.
Mount their wall, yet cannot attack. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 同人先號咷而後笑，大師克，相遇。
lines.english: Joining people: first wailing, afterward laughing. The great armies prevail and meet each other.
Joining people in the outskirts. No regret.

judgment.english: Great success.

image.chinese: 火在天上，大有。君子以遏惡揚善，順天休命。
image.english: Fire above heaven: Great Possession. The noble person restrains evil and raises good, following heaven's favorable mandate.

lines.english: No involvement in harm. No blame; difficulty brings no blame.
A great carriage for carrying. Have somewhere to go; no blame.

lines.chinese: 公用亨于天子，小人弗克。
lines.english: The duke offers a feast to the Son of Heaven. Petty people cannot do this.
Do not make it excessive. No blame.
Trust in mutual exchange, with dignity: good fortune.
Heaven itself helps him. Good fortune; nothing is unbeneficial.

judgment.english: Success. The noble person brings things to completion.

image.chinese: 地中有山，謙。君子以裒多益寡，稱物平施。
image.english: A mountain within the earth: Humility. The noble person reduces the abundant and increases the scarce, weighing things and distributing fairly.

lines.english: A humble, humble noble person. Use this to cross the great river. Good fortune.
Voicing humility. Constancy brings good fortune.
Laboring with humility, the noble person brings things to completion. Good fortune.
Nothing is unbeneficial. Spread humility.

lines.chinese: 不富以其鄰，利用侵伐，无不利。
lines.english: Not rich, together with one's neighbors. Invasion and attack are beneficial; nothing is unbeneficial.
Voicing humility. Using the army to campaign against towns and states is beneficial.

judgment.english: Establishing lords and deploying the army are beneficial.

image.chinese: 雷出地奮，豫。先王以作樂崇德，殷薦之上帝以配祖考。
image.english: Thunder emerges and stirs the earth: Readiness. The former kings made music to honor virtue, offering it abundantly to the High Lord and joining the ancestors to him.

lines.english: Voicing delight. Misfortune.
Firm as stone, without waiting a whole day. Constancy brings good fortune.
Looking upward in delight: regret. Delay brings regret.

lines.chinese: 由豫，大有得，勿疑。朋盍簪。
lines.english: The source of delight. Great gain. Do not doubt. Companions gather like hair around a clasp.
Constant illness, yet always not dying.
Darkened delight, completed. There is change; no blame.

judgment.english: Great success; constancy is beneficial. No blame.

image.chinese: 澤中有雷，隨。君子以嚮晦入宴息。
image.english: Thunder within the lake: Following. The noble person turns toward evening and enters rest.

lines.chinese: 官有渝，貞吉，出門交有功。
lines.english: The office changes. Constancy brings good fortune. Going out the gate and making connections brings accomplishment.
Bind oneself to the little boy; lose the grown man.

lines.chinese: 係丈夫，失小子，隨有求、得。利居貞。
lines.english: Bind oneself to the grown man; lose the little boy. Following, one obtains what one seeks. Remaining constant is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 隨有獲，貞凶。有孚在道，以明，何咎？
lines.english: Following brings capture. Constancy brings misfortune. There is trust on the way, with clarity. What blame?
Trust in the good. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 拘係之乃從，維之，王用亨于西山。
lines.english: Seize and bind him; then follow and hold him. The king offers sacrifice at the western mountain.

judgment.chinese: 元亨。利涉大川，先甲三日，後甲三日。
judgment.english: Great success. Crossing the great river is beneficial. Three days before jia, three days after jia.

image.chinese: 山下有風，蠱。君子以振民育德。
image.english: Wind below the mountain: Decay. The noble person stirs the people and nurtures virtue.

lines.chinese: 幹父之蠱，有子，考无咎，厲終吉。
lines.english: Set right the father's decay. There is a son: the deceased father has no blame. Danger; in the end good fortune.
Set right the mother's decay. One cannot remain rigidly constant.

lines.chinese: 幹父之蠱，小有悔，无大咎。
lines.english: Set right the father's decay. A little regret; no great blame.
Indulge the father's decay. Going brings shame.
Set right the father's decay. Receive praise.
Do not serve kings and lords. Hold one's own work high.

judgment.chinese: 元亨，利貞。至于八月有凶。
judgment.english: Great success; constancy is beneficial. On reaching the eighth month there is misfortune.

image.chinese: 澤上有地，臨。君子以教思无窮，容保民无疆。
image.english: Earth above the lake: Approach. The noble person's thought in teaching is inexhaustible, and his protection of the people has no bounds.

lines.english: Approaching together. Constancy brings good fortune.
Approaching together: good fortune. Nothing is unbeneficial.

lines.chinese: 甘臨，无攸利；既憂之，无咎。
lines.english: Sweet approach. Nothing is beneficial. Having become concerned about it, no blame.
Arriving approach. No blame.
Wise approach, fitting for a great ruler. Good fortune.
Sincere approach. Good fortune, no blame.

judgment.english: Wash the hands, but do not yet present the offering. There is trust, solemnly attentive.

image.chinese: 風行地上，觀。先王以省方觀民設教。
image.english: Wind moves over earth: Contemplation. The former kings visited the regions, observed the people and established teaching.

lines.english: A child's contemplation. For petty people, no blame; for the noble person, shame.
Peeping contemplation. A woman's constancy is beneficial.
Contemplate my life: advance or retreat.
Contemplate the state's splendor. Being the king's guest is beneficial.
Contemplate my life. For the noble person, no blame.
Contemplate his life. For the noble person, no blame.

judgment.english: Success. Using legal proceedings is beneficial.

image.chinese: 雷電噬嗑。先王以明罰勑法。
image.english: Thunder and lightning: Biting Together. The former kings clarified punishments and enforced laws.

lines.english: Feet in a shackle, hiding the toes. No blame.
Bite skin, hiding the nose. No blame.
Bite dried meat and encounter poison. Small shame; no blame.

lines.chinese: 噬乾胏，得金矢。利艱貞、吉。
lines.english: Bite dried meat with bone and obtain a metal arrow. Constancy in difficulty is beneficial. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 噬乾肉，得黃金。貞厲无咎。
lines.english: Bite dried meat and obtain yellow metal. Constancy is dangerous; no blame.
Bearing a cangue, hiding the ears. Misfortune.

judgment.english: Success. A little benefit in having somewhere to go.

image.chinese: 山下有火，賁。君子以明庶政，无敢折獄。
image.english: Fire below the mountain: Adornment. The noble person clarifies public affairs, but does not dare decide lawsuits.

lines.english: Adorn the toes. Leave the carriage and walk.
Adorn the beard.
Adorned and glistening. Lasting constancy brings good fortune.

lines.chinese: 賁如皤如，白馬翰如，匪寇，婚媾。
lines.english: Adorned, white; the white horse flies. Not robbers: marriage seekers.

lines.chinese: 賁于丘園，束帛戔戔，吝終吉。
lines.english: Adornment in hills and gardens. Bundles of silk are scant. Shame; in the end good fortune.
White adornment. No blame.

judgment.english: Having somewhere to go is unbeneficial.

image.chinese: 山附於地，剝。上以厚下安宅。
image.english: The mountain rests on earth: Stripping. Those above make those below substantial and secure their dwelling.

lines.english: Strip the bed at its legs. Disregarding constancy: misfortune.
Strip the bed at its frame. Disregarding constancy: misfortune.
Stripping it. No blame.
Strip the bed to the skin. Misfortune.
A string of fish, favor through palace women. Nothing is unbeneficial.

lines.chinese: 碩果不食，君子得輿，小人剝廬。
lines.english: A large fruit uneaten. The noble person gains a carriage; the petty person strips his hut.

judgment.chinese: 亨。出入无疾。朋來无咎。反復其道，七日來復。利有攸往。
judgment.english: Success. Going out and coming in without illness. Companions arrive without blame. Returning along the way: in seven days comes return. Having somewhere to go is beneficial.

image.chinese: 雷在地中，復。先王以至日閉關，商旅不行，后不省方。
image.english: Thunder within earth: Return. The former kings closed the passes on the solstice. Merchants and travelers did not move; the ruler did not inspect the regions.

lines.english: Return before going far. No great regret. Great good fortune.
Restful return. Good fortune.
Repeated return. Danger; no blame.
Walking in the middle, returning alone.
Sincere return. No regret.

lines.chinese: 迷復，凶，有災眚。用行師，終有大敗，以其國君凶，至于十年不克征。
lines.english: Lost return. Misfortune; disaster and calamity. Deploying the army ends in great defeat, with misfortune for the ruler. For ten years one cannot campaign.

judgment.chinese: 元亨，利貞。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。
judgment.english: Great success; constancy is beneficial. What is not correct brings calamity. Having somewhere to go is unbeneficial.

image.chinese: 天下雷行，物與无妄。先王以茂對時育萬物。
image.english: Thunder moves below heaven; things are without falseness. The former kings nurtured all things abundantly in accord with the seasons.

lines.english: Without falseness. Going brings good fortune.

lines.chinese: 不耕穫；不菑畬；則利有攸往。
lines.english: Without plowing, harvest; without clearing new land, mature fields. Then having somewhere to go is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 无妄之災，或繫之牛，行人之得，邑人之災。
lines.english: An unanticipated calamity. Someone ties an ox: the passerby gains it, the townspeople suffer disaster.
One may remain constant. No blame.
An unanticipated illness. Without medicine there is joy.
Without falseness, yet action brings calamity. Nothing is beneficial.

judgment.chinese: 利貞。不家食吉。利涉大川。
judgment.english: Constancy is beneficial. Not eating at home brings good fortune. Crossing the great river is beneficial.

image.chinese: 天在山中，大畜。君子以多識前言往行以畜其德。
image.english: Heaven within the mountain: Great Restraint. The noble person learns many former words and past deeds to accumulate virtue.

lines.english: There is danger. Stopping is beneficial.
The carriage loses its axle fastening.

lines.chinese: 良馬逐，利艱貞，曰閑輿衛，利有攸往。
lines.english: Good horses pursue. Constancy in difficulty is beneficial. Practice carriage defense daily. Having somewhere to go is beneficial.
A young ox's headboard. Great good fortune.
A castrated boar's tusk. Good fortune.
What a thoroughfare of heaven! Success.

judgment.english: Constancy brings good fortune. Observe nourishment; seek what fills the mouth yourself.

image.chinese: 山下有雷，頤。君子以慎言語、節飲食。
image.english: Thunder below the mountain: Nourishment. The noble person is careful with speech and moderate in food and drink.

lines.english: Abandon your numinous tortoise and watch my hanging jaws. Misfortune.
Inverted nourishment, opposing the norm, seeking nourishment on the hill. Advancing brings misfortune.

lines.chinese: 拂頤貞、凶，十年勿用，无攸利。
lines.english: Opposing nourishment. Constancy brings misfortune. For ten years do not act. Nothing is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 顛頤，吉。虎視眈眈，其欲逐逐，无咎。
lines.english: Inverted nourishment: good fortune. The tiger gazes intently; its desires pursue one another. No blame.

lines.chinese: 拂經，居貞、吉，不可涉大川。
lines.english: Opposing the norm. Remaining constant brings good fortune. One cannot cross the great river.
The source of nourishment. Danger; good fortune. Crossing the great river is beneficial.

judgment.english: The ridgepole bends. Having somewhere to go is beneficial. Success.

image.chinese: 澤滅木，大過。君子以獨立不懼，遯世无悶。
image.english: The lake submerges the trees: Great Excess. The noble person stands alone without fear and withdraws from the world without distress.

lines.english: Lay down white thatch. No blame.

lines.chinese: 枯楊生稊，老夫得其女妻，无不利。
lines.english: A withered poplar sends out shoots. An old man obtains a young wife. Nothing is unbeneficial.
The ridgepole bends. Misfortune.
The ridgepole rises. Good fortune. Other concerns bring shame.

lines.chinese: 枯楊生華，老婦得其士夫，无咎无譽。
lines.english: A withered poplar flowers. An old woman obtains a young husband. No blame, no praise.
Crossing too far, water covers the head. Misfortune; no blame.

judgment.english: There is trust. In the heart alone, success. Action has esteem.

image.chinese: 水洊至，習坎。君子以常德行、習教事。
image.english: Water arrives repeatedly: Repeated Pit. The noble person maintains virtue in action and practices the work of teaching.

lines.english: Repeated pit. Enter the pit's hollow. Misfortune.
The pit has danger. Seek a small gain.

lines.chinese: 來之坎坎，險且枕，入于坎窞，勿用。
lines.english: Coming and going, pit upon pit. Danger, and a place to rest. Enter the pit's hollow. Do not act.

lines.chinese: 樽酒、簋貳、用缶，納約自牖，終无咎。
lines.english: A jar of wine, two baskets, earthen vessels. Present a simple offering through the window. In the end no blame.
The pit is not overflowing; it has only reached level. No blame.

lines.chinese: 係用徽纆，寘于叢棘，三歲不得，凶。
lines.english: Bound with cords and ropes, placed among thorn bushes. For three years no release. Misfortune.

judgment.english: Constancy is beneficial. Success. Rearing a cow brings good fortune.

image.chinese: 明兩、作離。大人以繼明照于四方。
image.english: Brightness doubled makes Clinging. The great person continues brightness and illuminates the four quarters.

lines.english: Treading in confusion. Treat it with respect. No blame.
Yellow brightness. Great good fortune.

lines.chinese: 日昃之離，不鼓缶而歌，則大耋之嗟，凶。
lines.english: The brightness of the declining sun. If one does not beat the earthen jar and sing, then comes the lament of great old age. Misfortune.

lines.chinese: 突如、其來如，焚如，死如，棄如。
lines.english: Sudden is its coming; burning, dying, being cast away.
Tears stream out, grief and lamentation. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 王用出征，有嘉折首，獲匪其醜，无咎。
lines.english: The king goes out on campaign. There is merit in cutting off the chief, capturing those who are not merely his followers. No blame.

judgment.english: Success. Constancy is beneficial. Taking a woman in marriage brings good fortune.

image.chinese: 山上有澤，咸。君子以虛受人。
image.english: A lake above the mountain: Mutual Influence. The noble person empties himself to receive others.

lines.english: Influence in the big toe.
Influence in the calf. Misfortune. Staying brings good fortune.
Influence in the thigh. Hold to what one follows. Going brings shame.

lines.chinese: 貞吉。悔亡。憧憧往來，朋從爾思。
lines.english: Constancy brings good fortune; regret disappears. Restless coming and going: companions follow your thoughts.
Influence in the flesh of the back. No regret.
Influence in the jaw, cheeks and tongue.

judgment.english: Success. No blame. Constancy is beneficial. Having somewhere to go is beneficial.

image.chinese: 雷風恆。君子以立不易方。
image.english: Thunder and wind: Duration. The noble person stands firm without changing direction.

lines.english: Deeply digging for duration. Constancy brings misfortune. Nothing is beneficial.
Regret disappears.

lines.chinese: 不恆其德，或承之羞，貞吝。
lines.english: Not lasting in one's virtue, one may receive shame. Constancy brings shame.
No game in the field.

lines.chinese: 恆其德、貞，婦人吉，夫子凶。
lines.english: Lasting in one's virtue with constancy: good fortune for a woman, misfortune for a man.
Agitated duration. Misfortune.

judgment.english: Success. Small constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 天下有山，遯。君子以遠小人，不惡而嚴。
image.english: A mountain below heaven: Withdrawal. The noble person keeps petty people at a distance, with firmness rather than hatred.

lines.english: The tail of withdrawal. Danger. Do not undertake a journey.

lines.chinese: 執之用黃牛之革，莫之勝、說。
lines.english: Hold it with yellow oxhide; no one can undo it.
Bound withdrawal. Illness and danger. Keeping servants and concubines brings good fortune.
Willing withdrawal. Good fortune for the noble person; otherwise for the petty person.
Admirable withdrawal. Constancy brings good fortune.
Abundant withdrawal. Nothing is unbeneficial.

judgment.english: Constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 雷在天上，大壯。君子以非禮弗履。
image.english: Thunder above heaven: Great Strength. The noble person does not tread outside ritual propriety.

lines.english: Strength in the toes. Advancing brings misfortune; there is trust.
Constancy brings good fortune.

lines.chinese: 小人用壯，君子用罔，貞厲。羝羊觸藩，羸其角。
lines.english: The petty person uses strength; the noble person uses restraint. Constancy is dangerous. A ram butts a hedge, entangling its horns.

lines.chinese: 貞吉，悔亡。藩決不羸，壯于大輿之輹。
lines.english: Constancy brings good fortune; regret disappears. The hedge opens; no entanglement. Strength in the great carriage's axle fastening.
Lose the sheep in ease. No regret.

lines.chinese: 羝羊觸藩，不能退，不能遂，无攸利，艱則吉。
lines.english: A ram butts the hedge. It can neither retreat nor advance. Nothing is beneficial. Difficulty brings good fortune.

judgment.chinese: 康侯用錫馬蕃庶，晝日三接。
judgment.english: The honored lord is granted horses in abundance and received three times in a single day.

image.chinese: 明出地上，晉。君子以自昭明德。
image.english: Brightness emerges above earth: Advance. The noble person makes his bright virtue shine.

lines.chinese: 晉如摧如，貞吉。罔孚，裕无咎。
lines.english: Advancing, held back. Constancy brings good fortune. Without trust, remain generous: no blame.

lines.chinese: 晉如，愁如，貞吉。受茲介福于其王母。
lines.english: Advancing, sorrowing. Constancy brings good fortune. Receive this great blessing from the royal mother.
The multitude consents. Regret disappears.
Advancing like a large rat. Constancy is dangerous.

lines.chinese: 悔亡，失得勿恤。往吉，无不利。
lines.english: Regret disappears. Do not worry about loss or gain. Going brings good fortune; nothing is unbeneficial.

lines.chinese: 晉其角，維用伐邑，厲吉，无咎，貞吝。
lines.english: Advance with the horns. Use this only to attack one's town. Danger; good fortune, no blame. Constancy brings shame.

judgment.english: Constancy in difficulty is beneficial.

image.chinese: 明入地中，明夷。君子以莅眾用晦而明。
image.english: Brightness enters within earth: Wounded Brightness. The noble person governs the multitude by using obscurity, yet remains clear.

lines.chinese: 明夷于飛，垂其翼。君子于行，三日不食。有攸往，主人有言。
lines.english: Wounded brightness in flight, wings hanging down. The noble person travels, eating nothing for three days. Have somewhere to go; the host has words.

lines.chinese: 明夷、夷于左股，用拯馬、壯吉。
lines.english: Wounded brightness, wounded in the left thigh. Use a strong horse to rescue. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 明夷于南狩，得其大首，不可疾貞。
lines.english: Wounded brightness on the southern hunt. Capture the great chief. One cannot press constancy hastily.

lines.chinese: 入于左腹，獲明夷之心于出門庭。
lines.english: Enter the left belly. Obtain the heart of wounded brightness in going out of the courtyard gate.
Jizi's wounded brightness. Constancy is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 不明、晦。初登于天，後入于地。
lines.english: No brightness, but darkness. First ascend to heaven, afterward enter the earth.

judgment.english: A woman's constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 風自火出，家人。君子以言有物而行有恆。
image.english: Wind emerges from fire: The Household. The noble person's words have substance and his actions have duration.

lines.english: Guard the household. Regret disappears.
Pursue nothing outward; attend to food within. Constancy brings good fortune.

lines.chinese: 家人嗃嗃，悔厲，吉；婦子嘻嘻，終吝。
lines.english: The household is stern: regret and danger, yet good fortune. Wife and children laugh carelessly: in the end shame.
Enrich the household. Great good fortune.
The king arrives at the household. Do not worry. Good fortune.
There is trust and dignity. In the end good fortune.

judgment.english: Good fortune in small affairs.

image.chinese: 上火下澤，睽。君子以同而異。
image.english: Fire above, lake below: Divergence. The noble person remains different within togetherness.

lines.chinese: 悔亡。喪馬，勿逐自復。見惡人无咎。
lines.english: Regret disappears. Lose a horse: do not pursue it; it returns itself. See an evil person: no blame.
Meet the master in a lane. No blame.

lines.chinese: 見輿曳，其牛掣，其人天且劓，无初有終。
lines.english: See the carriage dragged back, its ox checked, its driver branded on the forehead and nose cut off. No beginning, but a completion.

lines.chinese: 睽孤，遇元夫，交孚，厲无咎。
lines.english: Isolated in divergence, meet the principal man. Exchange trust. Danger; no blame.
Regret disappears. One's clansman bites through skin. What blame in going?

lines.chinese: 睽孤，見豕負塗，載鬼一車，先張之弧，後說之弧，匪寇，婚媾。往遇雨，則吉。
lines.english: Isolated in divergence, see a pig covered in mud and a carriage loaded with ghosts. First draw the bow, afterward unstring it. Not robbers: marriage seekers. Go and meet rain; then good fortune.

judgment.chinese: 利西南，不利東北。利見大人。貞吉。
judgment.english: The southwest is beneficial; the northeast is unbeneficial. Seeing the great person is beneficial. Constancy brings good fortune.

image.chinese: 山上有水，蹇。君子以反身修德。
image.english: Water above the mountain: Limping. The noble person turns toward himself and cultivates virtue.

lines.english: Going: obstruction. Coming: praise.
The king's servant struggles through obstruction, for reasons other than his own person.
Going: obstruction. Coming: return.
Going: obstruction. Coming: connection.
Great obstruction. Companions come.
Going: obstruction. Coming: greatness. Good fortune. Seeing the great person is beneficial.

judgment.chinese: 利西南。无所往，其來復吉。有攸往，夙吉。
judgment.english: The southwest is beneficial. With nowhere to go, returning brings good fortune. With somewhere to go, early action brings good fortune.

image.chinese: 雷雨作，解。君子以赦過宥罪。
image.english: Thunder and rain arise: Release. The noble person pardons errors and forgives offenses.

lines.english: No blame.
On the hunt, capture three foxes and obtain a yellow arrow. Constancy brings good fortune.
Carrying a load while riding a carriage brings robbers. Constancy brings shame.
Release your big toe. Companions arrive, and then trust.

lines.chinese: 君子維有解，吉，有孚于小人。
lines.english: The noble person alone has release. Good fortune. There is trust among petty people.

lines.chinese: 公用射隼于高墉之上，獲之，无不利。
lines.english: The duke shoots a falcon atop a high wall and captures it. Nothing is unbeneficial.

judgment.chinese: 有孚，元吉，无咎可貞。利有攸往。曷之用，二簋可用享。
judgment.english: There is trust: great good fortune, no blame; one may remain constant. Having somewhere to go is beneficial. What should be used? Two baskets may be used for the offering.

image.chinese: 山下有澤，損。君子以懲忿窒欲。
image.english: A lake below the mountain: Decrease. The noble person restrains anger and checks desire.

lines.english: End the affair and go quickly. No blame. Consider how much to decrease.
Constancy is beneficial. Advancing brings misfortune. Do not decrease it; increase it.

lines.chinese: 三人行則損一人，一人行則得其友。
lines.english: Three people travel: one person is decreased. One person travels: he obtains a companion.
Decrease the illness; make haste and there is joy. No blame.

lines.chinese: 或益之十朋之龜，弗克違，元吉。
lines.english: Someone increases it with a tortoise worth ten pairs of shells; one cannot refuse. Great good fortune.

lines.chinese: 弗損，益之，无咎，貞吉，利有攸往，得臣无家。
lines.english: Do not decrease it; increase it. No blame. Constancy brings good fortune. Having somewhere to go is beneficial. Obtain a servant without a household.

judgment.english: Having somewhere to go is beneficial. Crossing the great river is beneficial.

image.chinese: 風雷益。君子以見善則遷，有過則改。
image.english: Wind and thunder: Increase. The noble person moves toward good on seeing it, and corrects faults when he has them.

lines.english: Undertaking great works is beneficial. Great good fortune; no blame.

lines.chinese: 或益之，十朋之龜弗克違。永貞吉。王用享于帝，吉。
lines.english: Someone increases it with a tortoise worth ten pairs of shells; one cannot refuse. Lasting constancy brings good fortune. The king sacrifices to the High Lord. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 益之，用凶事无咎。有孚，中行。告公用圭。
lines.english: Increase it through unfortunate affairs; no blame. There is trust, walking in the middle. Announce to the duke with a jade tablet.

lines.chinese: 中行告公，從，利用為依遷國。
lines.english: Walking in the middle, announce to the duke; he follows. Using a supporting ally to move the state is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 有孚惠心，勿問，元吉。有孚惠我德。
lines.english: There is trust and a benevolent heart. Do not ask: great good fortune. There is trust that favors my virtue.

lines.chinese: 莫益之，或擊之，立心勿恆，凶。
lines.english: No one increases it; someone strikes it. The heart's resolve does not last. Misfortune.

judgment.chinese: 揚于王庭，孚號有厲，告自邑。不利即戎，利有攸往。
judgment.english: Proclaim in the king's court. A truthful cry: there is danger. Announce from one's town. Taking up arms is unbeneficial. Having somewhere to go is beneficial.

image.chinese: 澤上於天，夬。君子以施祿及下，居德則忌。
image.english: The lake rises above heaven: Deciding. The noble person distributes stipends to those below; resting on virtue is to be feared.

lines.english: Strength in the front toes. Going without prevailing brings blame.
A watchful cry. In late night there are arms. Do not worry.

lines.chinese: 壯于頄，有凶。君子夬夬，獨行遇雨、若濡，有慍无咎。
lines.english: Strength in the cheekbones: misfortune. The noble person decides decisively. Walking alone, meeting rain, getting wet; there is anger, no blame.

lines.chinese: 臀无膚，其行次且。牽羊悔亡。聞言不信。
lines.english: Buttocks without skin, walking haltingly. Lead a sheep: regret disappears. Hearing words, one does not believe them.
Amaranth on high ground: decide decisively. Walking in the middle: no blame.
No cry. In the end there is misfortune.

judgment.english: The woman is strong. Do not take this woman in marriage.

image.chinese: 天下有風，姤。后以施命誥四方。
image.english: Wind below heaven: Encounter. The ruler spreads commands and proclaims to the four quarters.

lines.chinese: 繫于金柅，貞吉。有攸往，見凶，羸豕孚蹢躅。
lines.english: Tie it to a metal brake. Constancy brings good fortune. Having somewhere to go, one sees misfortune. The lean pig is sure to leap about.
The wrapping contains fish. No blame. Guests are unbeneficial.

lines.chinese: 臀无膚，其行次且，厲，无大咎。
lines.english: Buttocks without skin, walking haltingly. Danger; no great blame.
The wrapping contains no fish. Misfortune arises.

lines.chinese: 以杞包瓜，含章，有隕自天。
lines.english: Wrap the melon in willow. Hold beauty within. Something falls from heaven.
Encounter with the horns. Shame; no blame.

judgment.chinese: 亨，王假有廟。利見大人。亨，利貞，用大牲吉。利有攸往。
judgment.english: Success. The king arrives at the temple. Seeing the great person is beneficial. Success; constancy is beneficial. Using a great sacrificial animal brings good fortune. Having somewhere to go is beneficial.

image.chinese: 澤上於地，萃。君子以除戎器，戒不虞。
image.english: A lake above earth: Gathering. The noble person repairs weapons and prepares for the unforeseen.

lines.chinese: 有孚不終，乃亂乃萃，若號一握為笑，勿恤，往无咎。
lines.english: There is trust, but it does not last; then disorder, then gathering. If one cries out, a grasp of the hand turns it to laughter. Do not worry. Going brings no blame.
Drawn together: good fortune, no blame. With trust, the simple spring sacrifice is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 萃如嗟如，无攸利，往无咎，小吝。
lines.english: Gathering and sighing. Nothing is beneficial. Going brings no blame; small shame.
Great good fortune. No blame.

lines.chinese: 萃有位，无咎。匪孚，元、永貞悔亡。
lines.english: Gathering has a position. No blame. Without trust: great, lasting constancy makes regret disappear.
Sighing and lamenting, tears and nasal discharge. No blame.

judgment.chinese: 元亨。用見大人，勿恤。南征吉。
judgment.english: Great success. Go to see the great person; do not worry. A southern campaign brings good fortune.

image.chinese: 地中生木，升。君子以順德，積小以高大。
image.english: Wood grows within earth: Rising. The noble person follows virtue and accumulates small things to reach height and greatness.

lines.english: Trusted rising. Great good fortune.
With trust, the simple spring sacrifice is beneficial. No blame.
Rise into an empty town.
The king offers sacrifice at Mount Qi. Good fortune; no blame.
Constancy brings good fortune. Ascend the steps.
Rising in darkness. Unceasing constancy is beneficial.

judgment.chinese: 亨。貞大人吉，无咎。有言不信。
judgment.english: Success. Constancy: good fortune for the great person, no blame. Spoken words are not believed.

image.chinese: 澤无水，困。君子以致命遂志。
image.english: A lake without water: Confinement. The noble person gives his life to fulfill his purpose.

lines.chinese: 臀困于株木，入于幽谷，三歲不覿。
lines.english: Buttocks confined by a bare tree. Enter a dark valley. For three years see nothing.

lines.chinese: 困于酒食，朱紱方來。利用享祀。征凶无咎。
lines.english: Confined amid wine and food. The scarlet knee-coverings are coming. Sacrificial offerings are beneficial. Advancing brings misfortune; no blame.

lines.chinese: 困于石，據于蒺蔾，入于其宮，不見其妻，凶。
lines.english: Confined by stone, resting on thorns. Enter the palace and do not see one's wife. Misfortune.

lines.chinese: 來徐徐，困于金車，吝，有終。
lines.english: Coming slowly, confined by a metal carriage. Shame; there is a completion.

lines.chinese: 劓刖，困于赤紱，乃徐有說，利用祭祀。
lines.english: Nose and feet cut off; confined by the red knee-coverings. Gradually there is release. Sacrificial offerings are beneficial.

lines.chinese: 困于葛藟，于臲卼，曰動悔有悔，征吉。
lines.english: Confined by vines, in an unstable place. Say: movement brings regret. Having regret, advancing brings good fortune.

judgment.chinese: 改邑不改井，无喪无得。往來井井。汔至，亦未繘井，羸其瓶，凶。
judgment.english: Change the town, but do not change the well. Neither loss nor gain. Coming and going, they draw from the well. Nearly reaching the water, yet not having drawn it: break the jar. Misfortune.

image.chinese: 木上有水，井。君子以勞民勸相。
image.english: Water above wood: The Well. The noble person encourages the people to labor and help one another.

lines.english: The muddy well is not drunk from. No animals at the old well.
In the well's hollow, shoot at small fish. The jar is broken and leaks.

lines.chinese: 井渫不食，為我心惻。可用汲，王明，並受其福。
lines.english: The well is cleared, but not drunk from. My heart is grieved. It can be used for drawing. The king is bright; all receive its blessing.
The well is lined with masonry. No blame.
The well is clear: a cold spring. Drink.
The well is drawn from; do not cover it. There is trust: great good fortune.

judgment.chinese: 巳日乃孚。元亨，利貞，悔亡。
judgment.english: On the si day, then there is trust. Great success; constancy is beneficial. Regret disappears.

image.chinese: 澤中有火，革。君子以治厤明時。
image.english: Fire within the lake: Changing the Hide. The noble person orders the calendar and clarifies the seasons.

lines.english: Bind firmly with yellow oxhide.
On the si day, then change it. Advancing brings good fortune; no blame.

lines.chinese: 征凶。貞厲。革言三就有孚。
lines.english: Advancing brings misfortune. Constancy is dangerous. When talk of change has been completed three times, there is trust.
Regret disappears. There is trust. Changing the mandate brings good fortune.
The great person changes like a tiger. Even before divination, there is trust.

lines.chinese: 君子豹變，小人革面，征凶，居貞吉。
lines.english: The noble person changes like a leopard; petty people change their faces. Advancing brings misfortune. Remaining constant brings good fortune.

judgment.english: Great good fortune. Success.

image.chinese: 木上有火，鼎。君子以正位凝命。
image.english: Fire above wood: The Cauldron. The noble person corrects his position and consolidates the mandate.

lines.chinese: 鼎顛趾，利出否。得妾以其子，无咎。
lines.english: The cauldron's legs overturn. Removing stale contents is beneficial. Obtain a concubine through her son. No blame.

lines.chinese: 鼎有實，我仇有疾，不我能即，吉。
lines.english: The cauldron has substance. My counterpart has illness and cannot approach me. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 鼎耳革，其行塞，雉膏不食，方雨，虧悔，終吉。
lines.english: The cauldron's ears change. Its movement is blocked; pheasant fat is not eaten. Rain is coming. Regret lessens; in the end good fortune.

lines.chinese: 鼎折足，覆公餗，其形渥，凶。
lines.english: The cauldron's leg breaks. The duke's food is spilled; its form is soiled. Misfortune.
The cauldron has yellow ears and a metal carrying bar. Constancy is beneficial.
The cauldron has a jade carrying bar. Great good fortune; nothing is unbeneficial.

judgment.chinese: 亨。震來虩虩，笑言啞啞，震驚百里，不喪匕鬯。
judgment.english: Success. Thunder comes: fear and trembling. Laughing words resound. Thunder startles a hundred li, but the ladle and sacrificial wine are not lost.

image.chinese: 洊雷、震。君子以恐懼脩省。
image.english: Repeated thunder: Shock. The noble person examines and corrects himself with fear and awe.

lines.english: Thunder comes: fear and trembling. Afterward laughing words resound. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 震來厲，億喪貝，躋于九陵，勿逐，七日得。
lines.english: Thunder comes: danger. Expect to lose valuables; climb the nine hills. Do not pursue. In seven days obtain them.
Thunder: dismayed and unsettled. Moving through thunder brings no calamity.
Thunder sinks into mud.
Thunder going and coming: danger. Consider that nothing is lost, though there are affairs.

lines.chinese: 震索索，視矍矍，征凶。震不于其躬、于其鄰、无咎。婚媾有言。
lines.english: Thunder: trembling; looking about in alarm. Advancing brings misfortune. Thunder reaches not oneself but one's neighbor. No blame. Marriage brings words.

judgment.chinese: 艮其背，不獲其身，行其庭，不見其人，无咎。
judgment.english: Still the back; do not grasp the body. Walk in the courtyard; do not see its people. No blame.

image.chinese: 兼山，艮。君子以思不出其位。
image.english: Mountains together: Stillness. The noble person's thoughts do not go beyond his position.

lines.english: Still the toes. No blame. Lasting constancy is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 艮其腓，不拯其隨，其心不快。
lines.english: Still the calf. One cannot rescue what follows; the heart is unhappy.
Still the waist; split the back muscles. Danger scorches the heart.
Still the torso. No blame.
Still the jaw. Speech has order. Regret disappears.
Substantial stillness. Good fortune.

judgment.english: A woman marries: good fortune. Constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 山上有木，漸。君子以居賢德善俗。
image.english: Wood above the mountain: Gradual Advance. The noble person dwells in worthy virtue and improves customs.

lines.chinese: 鴻漸于干。小子厲有言，无咎。
lines.english: The wild goose gradually advances to the bank. The young son is in danger; there are words. No blame.
The wild goose gradually advances to a rock. Eating and drinking joyfully. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 鴻漸于陸。夫征不復，婦孕不育，凶。利禦寇。
lines.english: The wild goose gradually advances to dry land. The husband campaigns and does not return; the wife conceives but does not raise the child. Misfortune. Resisting robbers is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 鴻漸于木，或得其桷，无咎。
lines.english: The wild goose gradually advances to a tree. Perhaps it finds a level branch. No blame.

lines.chinese: 鴻漸于陵，婦三歲不孕，終莫之勝，吉。
lines.english: The wild goose gradually advances to a hill. For three years the wife does not conceive. In the end nothing overcomes it. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 鴻漸于陸，其羽可用為儀，吉。
lines.english: The wild goose gradually advances to dry land. Its feathers can be used for ceremonial display. Good fortune.

judgment.english: Advancing brings misfortune. Nothing is beneficial.

image.chinese: 澤上有雷，歸妹。君子以永終知敝。
image.english: Thunder above the lake: The Marrying Maiden. The noble person considers the lasting end and knows what decays.

lines.english: The maiden marries as a younger sister. The lame can walk. Advancing brings good fortune.
The one-eyed can see. The secluded person's constancy is beneficial.
The maiden marries as an attendant, then returns to marry as a younger sister.
The maiden delays the date. There is a time for late marriage.

lines.chinese: 帝乙歸妹，其君之袂不如其娣之袂良。月幾望、吉。
lines.english: Di Yi marries off the maiden. Her lady's sleeves are not as fine as her younger sister's sleeves. The moon is nearly full. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 女承筐，无實，士刲羊，无血，无攸利。
lines.english: The woman holds a basket without contents; the man cuts a sheep without blood. Nothing is beneficial.

judgment.english: Success. The king reaches it. Do not worry. Be like the sun at midday.

image.chinese: 雷電皆至，豐。君子以折獄致刑。
image.english: Thunder and lightning both arrive: Abundance. The noble person decides lawsuits and carries out punishments.

lines.chinese: 遇其配主，雖旬无咎，往有尚。
lines.english: Meet the matching lord. Though a full ten days, no blame. Going has esteem.

lines.chinese: 豐其蔀，日中見斗。往得疑疾，有孚，發若吉。
lines.english: Abundant screens: at midday see the Dipper. Going brings suspicion and illness. There is trust; it opens forth. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 豐其沛，日中見沬，折其右肱，无咎。
lines.english: Abundant covering: at midday see the small stars. Break the right arm. No blame.

lines.chinese: 豐其蔀，日中見斗，遇其夷主，吉。
lines.english: Abundant screens: at midday see the Dipper. Meet the equal lord. Good fortune.
Beauty comes. There is celebration and praise. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 豐其屋，蔀其家，闚其戶，闃其无人，三歲不覿，凶。
lines.english: Make the roof abundant; screen the household. Peer through its door: silent, no people. For three years see nothing. Misfortune.

judgment.english: Small success. The traveler's constancy brings good fortune.

image.chinese: 山上有火，旅。君子以明慎用刑而不留獄。
image.english: Fire above the mountain: Traveling. The noble person is clear and careful in using punishment and does not prolong imprisonment.

lines.english: The traveler busies himself with trifles. This is how he brings disaster on himself.

lines.chinese: 旅即次，懷其資，得童僕貞。
lines.english: The traveler reaches lodging, carries his resources, and gains a young servant's constancy.

lines.chinese: 旅焚其次，喪其童僕貞，厲。
lines.english: The traveler's lodging burns; he loses his young servant's constancy. Danger.

lines.chinese: 旅于處，得其資斧，我心不快。
lines.english: The traveler stays in a resting place and obtains resources and an axe. My heart is unhappy.
Shoot a pheasant: one arrow is lost. In the end receive praise and a mandate.

lines.chinese: 鳥焚其巢，旅人先笑後號咷。喪牛于易，凶。
lines.english: The bird's nest burns. The traveler first laughs, afterward wails. Lose the ox in ease. Misfortune.

judgment.chinese: 小亨。利有攸往。利見大人。
judgment.english: Small success. Having somewhere to go is beneficial. Seeing the great person is beneficial.

image.chinese: 隨風，巽。君子以申命行事。
image.english: Following winds: Penetration. The noble person repeats commands and carries out affairs.

lines.english: Advance and retreat. The warrior's constancy is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 巽在床下，用史巫、紛若吉、无咎。
lines.english: Penetrating below the bed. Employ scribes and shamans in abundance. Good fortune; no blame.
Repeated penetration. Shame.
Regret disappears. On the hunt obtain three kinds of game.

lines.chinese: 貞吉，悔亡，无不利，无初有終。先庚三日，後庚三日，吉。
lines.english: Constancy brings good fortune; regret disappears. Nothing is unbeneficial. No beginning, but a completion. Three days before geng, three days after geng. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 巽在床下，喪其資斧，貞凶。
lines.english: Penetrating below the bed. Lose resources and axe. Constancy brings misfortune.

judgment.english: Success. Constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 麗澤，兌。君子以朋友講習。
image.english: Joined lakes: Joy. The noble person discusses and practices with friends.

lines.english: Harmonious joy. Good fortune.
Trustful joy. Good fortune; regret disappears.
Coming joy. Misfortune.
Deliberating joy, not yet at peace. Set apart illness: there is joy.
Trust in stripping away. There is danger.
Drawn into joy.

judgment.chinese: 亨。王假有廟。利涉大川，利貞。
judgment.english: Success. The king arrives at the temple. Crossing the great river is beneficial; constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 風行水上，渙。先王以享于帝，立廟。
image.english: Wind moves over water: Dispersal. The former kings sacrificed to the High Lord and established temples.

lines.english: Use a strong horse to rescue. Good fortune.
In dispersal, hurry to one's support. Regret disappears.
Disperse one's own person. No regret.

lines.chinese: 渙其群，元吉。渙有丘，匪夷所思。
lines.english: Disperse the group. Great good fortune. Dispersal has a mound; not what ordinary thought imagines.

lines.chinese: 渙汗其大號，渙王居，无咎。
lines.english: Disperse sweat with the great cry. Disperse the king's residence. No blame.
Disperse the blood; depart far away and come out. No blame.

judgment.english: Success. Bitter restriction cannot be held constant.

image.chinese: 澤上有水，節。君子以制數度，議德行。
image.english: Water above the lake: Restriction. The noble person establishes numbers and measures and discusses virtue and conduct.

lines.english: Do not leave the inner courtyard. No blame.
Do not leave the gate courtyard. Misfortune.
Without restriction, then sighing. No blame.
Peaceful restriction. Success.
Sweet restriction. Good fortune. Going has esteem.
Bitter restriction. Constancy brings misfortune. Regret disappears.

judgment.english: Pigs and fish: good fortune. Crossing the great river is beneficial; constancy is beneficial.

image.chinese: 澤上有風，中孚。君子以議獄緩死。
image.english: Wind above the lake: Inner Trust. The noble person deliberates on imprisonment and delays execution.

lines.english: Preparedness brings good fortune. Other concerns disturb peace.

lines.chinese: 鳴鶴在陰，其子和之。我有好爵，吾與爾靡之。
lines.english: A calling crane in the shade; its young answer. I have a fine cup; I will share it with you.

lines.chinese: 得敵，或鼓或罷，或泣或歌。
lines.english: Find an opposing counterpart. Now drumming, now stopping; now weeping, now singing.
The moon is nearly full. The paired horse is lost. No blame.
There is trust, binding together. No blame.
The cock's cry rises to heaven. Constancy brings misfortune.

judgment.chinese: 亨。利貞。可小事，不可大事。飛鳥遺之音，不宜上，宜下，大吉。
judgment.english: Success. Constancy is beneficial. Small affairs are possible; great affairs are not. A flying bird leaves its cry. Upward is unsuitable; downward is suitable. Great good fortune.

image.chinese: 山上有雷，小過。君子以行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉。
image.english: Thunder above the mountain: Small Excess. The noble person exceeds in respect in conduct, grief in mourning, and frugality in spending.

lines.english: The flying bird brings misfortune.

lines.chinese: 過其祖，遇其妣。不及其君，遇其臣。无咎。
lines.english: Pass the grandfather, meet the grandmother. Do not reach the ruler; meet his servant. No blame.
Failing to exceed, guard against it. Someone following may kill him. Misfortune.

lines.chinese: 无咎。弗過、遇之，往厲必戒。勿用永貞。
lines.english: No blame. Do not exceed; meet it. Going is dangerous: take care. Do not use lasting constancy.

lines.chinese: 密雲不雨，自我西郊。公弋取彼在穴。
lines.english: Dense clouds, no rain, from our western outskirts. The duke shoots with a corded arrow and takes the one in the cave.

lines.chinese: 弗遇、過之，飛鳥離之，凶，是謂災眚。
lines.english: Do not meet it; pass beyond it. The flying bird leaves it. Misfortune: this is called disaster and calamity.

judgment.english: Success. Small constancy is beneficial. At the beginning good fortune; at the end disorder.

image.chinese: 水在火上，既濟。君子以思患而豫防之。
image.english: Water above fire: Already Across. The noble person thinks about trouble and prepares against it.

lines.english: Drag the wheel; wet the tail. No blame.
The woman loses her carriage screen. Do not pursue. In seven days obtain it.

lines.chinese: 高宗伐鬼方，三年克之，小人勿用。
lines.english: Gaozong attacks the Ghost Region. In three years he conquers it. Do not employ petty people.
Fine cloth has ragged clothing beside it. Be watchful all day.

lines.chinese: 東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之禴祭實受其福。
lines.english: The eastern neighbor slaughters an ox; this is less than the western neighbor's simple spring sacrifice, which truly receives blessing.
Wet the head. Danger.

judgment.chinese: 亨。小狐汔濟，濡其尾，无攸利。
judgment.english: Success. The little fox nearly crosses, wetting its tail. Nothing is beneficial.

image.chinese: 火在水上，未濟。君子以慎辨物居方。
image.english: Fire above water: Not Yet Across. The noble person carefully distinguishes things and settles their places.

lines.english: Wet the tail. Shame.
Drag the wheel. Constancy brings good fortune.
Not yet across. Advancing brings misfortune. Crossing the great river is beneficial.

lines.chinese: 貞吉，悔亡，震用伐鬼方，三年，有賞于大國。
lines.english: Constancy brings good fortune; regret disappears. Stirring to attack the Ghost Region, in three years there are rewards from the great state.

lines.chinese: 貞吉，无悔。君子之光，有孚、吉。
lines.english: Constancy brings good fortune; no regret. The noble person's brightness: there is trust. Good fortune.

lines.chinese: 有孚于飲酒，无咎。濡其首，有孚失是。
lines.english: There is trust in drinking wine. No blame. Wet the head: there is trust, but what is right is lost.
